actions.description: Click the game once. If the bar is on the dot, this pops it (the bar reverses and the dot jumps). If not, the game ends.
Do nothing for this decision and let the bar keep turning.

notes: One decision is 33 game-ms. In that time the bar turns stepDeg degrees in direction dir. gapDeg is how many degrees the bar still has to turn to be centred on the dot; a negative value means it has just passed the dot's centre. gapNextDeg is what gapDeg will be at the next decision if you wait. onDot is true when |gapDeg| <= hitTolDeg. tapOutcome predicts what a tap now does: 'pop' means the bar is on the dot, 'gameOver' means it is off the dot, and 'uncertain' means the dot is still moving (dotMoving). waitOutcome predicts what waiting one decision does: 'safe' means the bar will still be short of the dot's centre, 'crossesDot' means it will cross the dot's centre before the next decision, and 'gameOver' means it will be past the dot and out of reach. RULES: if gameOver is true -> wait. Otherwise, if tapOutcome is 'pop' and waitOutcome is not 'safe' -> tap, because this is the last decision where the bar is on the dot before it crosses the dot. Otherwise -> wait. A tap at any other moment ends the game, so when in doubt, wait. pops counts the dots popped so far. unknown lists objects that were not recognised, with their position and size; they are not threats.
